body: feed, soap, and a clean jar, paid cash. my note below says a medicinal odor came from the sprayer trial; the driver grew dizzy before the shelter message aired.
title: coat pocket note — at tuesday dawn
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a medicinal odor while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Pocket list of witnesses
body: I heard three shots, then the person taking statements told me the file would say two. He said the third sound might have come from a car door. I put a mark beside it, because the woman on the ground heard it too.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
